inputs.modified_text: Tom Homan wouldn’t rule out immigration enforcement at polling places, and his “what are Democrats ‘afraid of’” line sounds less like reassurance than a deliberate attempt to make people question whether voting will be safe. The administration is giving inconsistent answers, and that ambiguity looks useful: keep the threat hanging over polling places while denying responsibility for the intimidation it creates.
